messages.subject: Weed detection
parts:
Hello everyone,

I would like to obtain a vegetation index for images taken by an RGB camera, but the problem is there are a lot of weeds that will bias indices like the GLI, how can I eliminate them or consider them as a background? thank you.

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Weed detection
parts:
Hi there,

One option is to use the buffer or the plot_size paramter in the function fieldShape render to creat plot grids as close as possible to your plants. 

More information: https://github.com/filipematias23/FIELDimageR.Extra#p3

The goal is to avoid extracting weeds pixels..!

Hope it helps,
Filipe
